{{Top}}
[[File:Endor_plants.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Green flora on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]]]
{{Quote|I need you to gather grasses and plants for it to eat. The greener, the better. Understand?|Dass Jennir to H2, the former tending to an injured animal|<ref name="Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 3">[[Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness 3|''Dark Times—Out of the Wilderness'' 3]]</ref>}}
'''Plants''', collectively referred to as '''flora''' by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], were an extremely vast group of organisms found on countless [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and the major producers in an ecosystem. In some worlds, such as [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]], plants were the dominant life form. [[Tree/Legends|Trees]], [[Grass/Legends|grasses]], herbs, [[Bush/Legends|bushes]], [[Fern (plant)/Legends|ferns]] and [[Moss/Legends|mosses]] were the most prominent forms of plants. [[Sentience/Legends|Sentient]] plants were not very common in the galaxy, with [[Species/Legends|species]] like the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]], the [[Daltarri (species)|Daltarri]], the [[Ergesh]], the [[Orgon]], the [[Thorn monster]], the [[Pliith]], and the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] being rare examples of plants to have developed sentience. Throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], some plants were used for sustenance, others as tools, medicine, or even weapons. Sentient beings also grew vegetal organisms for the sole purpose of enjoying their natural beauty.

==Biology==
{{Quote|The grass doesn't mind being walked on, but it does feel it.''"<br />"''Everything that's alive can feel what happens to it. That's an important truth to remember.|Jaina Solo and Leia Organa Solo|<ref name="BTS">''[[Before the Storm]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Meditation_Garden.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Many types of plants were kept in the [[Jedi Temple meditation gardens|Meditation Garden]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].]]
Plants were living organisms of the kind exemplified by [[Tree/Legends|trees]], [[Bush/Legends|shrubs]], herbs, [[Grass/Legends|grasses]], [[Fern (plant)/Legends|ferns]], and [[Moss/Legends|mosses]].<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> They were collectively referred to as flora by the [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]].<ref name="TGF">[[Star Wars Episode I: The Gungan Frontier|''Star Wars'' Episode I: ''The Gungan Frontier'']]</ref> Nearly every [[Planet/Legends|world]] with [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] contained flora.<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> Most commonly, plants absorbed [[Water/Legends|water]] and inorganic substances through their roots, and synthesized both nutrients in soil and [[Star/Legends|sunlight]].<ref name="AE" /> A [[Unidentified jungle world (Kamdon system)|jungle world]] in the [[Kamdon system/Legends|Kamdon system]] experienced seasonal [[Meteor shower/Legends|meteor showers]] where [[Meteor/Legends|meteors]] would enter the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] and tear through its surface, destroying untold acres of foliage, but also brought nutrients that the jungle needed to grow.<ref name="SW 30">[[Star Wars (1998) 30|''Star Wars'' (1998) 30]]</ref>

Plants could also be grown in artificial light.<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight audio drama">[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Jedi Knight'' audio drama]]</ref> On desert worlds like [[Byss (Abyssin)/Legends|Byss]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], plants had developed extensive taproots to extract water from the deep underground layers.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> However, there existed carnivorous plants, which derived most of their nutrients from trapping and digesting animal victims.<ref name="GoF:S">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Spore]]''</ref>

Plants typically grew in a permanent site, but some could move about in search of better light, nutrients or soils.<ref name="AE" /> As plants grew, they went to seed to bear their young, and then slowly decayed to organic matter and fertilized their habitat for subsequent generations.<ref name="YJK:JUS">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Jedi Under Siege]]''</ref> Plant life could also be found underwater, in which case it was often known as [[Algae/Legends|alga]].<ref name="WSW">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref> Within a given ecosystem, the diversity of plant life could be extremely high&mdash;on the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] alone, there existed more than 8,000 different species of grass.<ref name="FF18">{{FactFile|18|ALD 1-4|Alderaan}}</ref>

Seed plants bore specific reproductive organs known as flowers. The basic structure of flowers was much the same across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], with a stamen, anther, and pollen. The pollen was a microscopic powder the spread of which allowed plants to reproduce, and was transported by various pollination-agents like the wind, [[Insect/Legends|insects]], or other animals.<ref name="DN:JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> The flying, non-sentient insects called [[Bee/Legends|bees]] were known to bumble their way in the blossoms, thus helping pollinate those plants and ensure their survival.<ref name="Y:DR">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

Animal species often found it difficult to communicate with plants, since their entire life was based upon an existence where food was present every day. They lacked many concepts [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other animal species found natural, but some plants were, in fact, [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]]. Vegetal species typically possessed passive natural defenses, such as burrs<ref name="AE" /> [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] leaves<ref name="WGFEA">''[[Wicket Goes Fishing: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> or [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]].<ref name="PoG1">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]''</ref> On the planet [[Cona/Legends|Cona]], water was scarce, and many plants had evolved ways to defend their water supply, which they stored in gastric pods underground. The plants would poison the water, make thorn traps, and some were carnivorous.<ref name="Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

[[File:Felucia-wide.png|thumb|right|340px|The planet [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] had a diversity of bizarre plants.]]
Even regular, non-sentient plants were suffused with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], like any other type of lifeform. They could "feel" what happened to them and had a certain awareness of their surroundings, but they were not considered properly conscious.<ref name="BTS" /> On the contrary, some plant species like the [[Neti/Legends|Neti]] from [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]],<ref name="UAA">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> the [[Ergesh]] from [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]],<ref name="AE" /> or the [[Revwien/Legends|Revwien]] from [[Revyia]]<ref name="Galaxy Guide">''[[Galaxy Guide 12: Aliens — Enemies and Allies]]''</ref> had evolved to full sentience, while others like the [[fftssfft]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] were only semi-sapient.<ref name="COE">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/feature20081201.html|text=Castaways of Endor|int=Castaways of Endor}}</ref>

==Flowers and plants in culture==
{{Quote|The flowers are lovely. Thank you.''"<br />"''We still on for dinner tonight?|Teela Kaarz and Villian Dance|<ref name="ds">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> }}
In the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], many species would [[Diet/Legends|feed]] on plants, either exclusively&mdash;in the case of herbivores&mdash;or inclusively&mdash;in the case of omnivores.<ref name="AE" /> Non-sentient plants provided many parts that were marketed as food, including their leaves, [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]], roots, and seeds. Such edible plant parts included the [[manak]] [[Manak leaf|leaves]],<ref name="WSW" /> the [[avedame fruit]]<ref name="MS:JH">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref> and the [[ruik root]].<ref name="RC:TZ">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> Others were used for their medicinal properties, like the [[Bachani/Legends|bachani]] plant from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]],<ref name="TSL">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> the [[namana]] fruits from [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]],<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> the carnivorous [[Reeksa/Legends|reeksa]] plant on [[Iego/Legends|Iego]]<ref name="Mystery of a Thousand Moons">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> or the rare [[Bota/Legends|bota]] species that could be found on [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> The scientific study of plants and their properties was called botany. Some species produced particularly devoted botanists: the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] from [[Moltok/Legends|Moltok]] were reputed for working medical miracles using plants,<ref name="LCOJ">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref> and the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] were committed to studying and preserving the lush ecosystem of their planet.<ref name="GoF:S" />[[File:Mawin.jpg|thumb|200px||left|The [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Mawin]] watering her plants]] '''Plant fiber''' could be used to make the type of [[Paper/Legends|paper]] used in ancient scrolls.<ref name="The Last Jedi novel">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

In certain cases, plants could even be used as weapons, like the infamous [[grenade fungi]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] or the [[Widowmaker (plant)|widowmakers]] of [[Dononter Minor]].<ref name="Gamer">{{GamerCite|9|Endor and the Moddell Sector}}</ref> The [[Barundi]] believed that when a person strays from peace without provocation, they are in need of "assisted reincarnation". The offender was then beaten to [[Death/Legends|death]] in public with large flowers. The true cause of death, however, is most likely from the poisonous thorns in the petals.<ref name="Vassilika">''[[Star Wars: Underworld: The Yavin Vassilika]]''</ref>

Most medicines, even those who are now synthesized, had their beginnings in forest environments. Without medicinal plants, [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]] would be completely dependent on chemical cures, many of which were less effective than natural ones. Some medicines, such as [[Shiarha Root]], could not be synthesized. Furthermore, bacteria and other disease-causing organisms tended to mutate and become resistant to medicines, and new ones had to be found to combat deadly diseases.<ref name="The Quality of Mercy">{{JournalCite|1|The Quality of Mercy}}</ref> One important source of exotic plants that were used for pharmaceutical purposes was the planet [[Meris III]], where a small harvesting station and landing field oversaw harvesting. Illegal harvesters would sometimes try to steal the plants and take them to other planets for processing.<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume Three]]''</ref>

[[Plant Surge]] was a was a [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force power/Legends|power]] that was based around the channeling of life essence into plants, causing them to grow suddenly. Although this skill was common among [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Ithorian religion|priests]], few [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had mastered it.<ref name="Power of the Jedi Sourcebook">''[[Power of the Jedi Sourcebook]]''</ref> The technique could be used to make plants lash out at the enemy during battle.<ref name="Jedi Academy Training Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

In the [[galactic community]], flowers were often used for decorative purpose, either cut or not cut. Flowers could be used inside a home in order to make it more beautiful.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard">''[[Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard]]''</ref> Cut flowers could be kept in vases<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> filled with [[Water/Legends|water]] or made into bouquets, which were offered as tokens of love or respect.<ref name="ds" />

[[File:Ithorian-NEGAS.png|thumb|right|220px|An Ithorian tending to plant life.]] Some [[Gender/Legends|women]] liked to have flowers twisted in their [[Hair/Legends|hair]],<ref name="Legacy of the Force: Revelation">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref> or tucked behind their [[Ear/Legends|ear]].<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard" /> People would also cultivate certain plants and flowers like the deep red [[Malreaux rose]]s because of their agreeable appearance and smell:<ref name="Y:DR" /> for example, the [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] used to grow purple blossoms in the courtyard of their [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]].<ref name="A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Many people liked to liven up and enhance the beauty of their property by having a garden filled with plants like [[Tree/Legends|trees]], [[Bush/Legends|shrubs]] or flowers.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard" /> The [[Grand Palace of Gala]] was famous for its extensive gardens, where every plant, tree, and flower native to [[Gala]] was represented.<ref name="Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Mark of the Crown]]''</ref> [[Tchuspera]] bushes could be found decorating avenues on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-12-tales-of-the-new-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 12: Tales of the New Republic}}</ref> Even the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] enjoyed a botanical garden complete with many flowers of different colors within his [[Emperor's skyhook|personal skyhook]].<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> Plants were also used to decorate public places. For example, the wall surrounding [[Eliior|the capital]] of the planet [[Romin]] was planted with [[cloudflower]] vines.<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Changing of the Guard" />

The brandishing of a flower was also recognized as a universal symbol of peace. It was notably used by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] pacifists&mdash;a rarity among their kind.<ref name="H&R">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> The [[Barundi]] would often greet strangers by presenting them with flowers.<ref name="Vassilika" /> Similarly, when the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] from [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] first met the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], the elite soldiers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they welcomed them with flowers. However, when the curious Ewoks tried to use a stormtrooper's [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] rifle for a flower holder, the soldier opened fire.<ref name="ApEnd">{{Tales|14|Apocalypse Endor}}</ref>

Plantlike and floral motifs were also broadly used in decorative arts, especially on worlds that preserved the natural beauty of their landscapes, like [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWV">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Sometimes, the [[Clothing/Legends|clothes]] of [[Gender/Legends|females]] were decorated with flower-like ornaments,<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref> and pieces of architecture were adorned with stylized vegetal motifs.<ref name="CEIII2">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 2|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 2]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Plant life was first introduced in the original [[Original trilogy|''Star Wars'' trilogy]], which featured many real-life plants. The forests scenes of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] were shot at [[Wikipedia:Redwood National and State Parks|Redwood National Park]] in [[Wikipedia:Crescent City|Crescent City]], [[Wikipedia:California|California]],<ref name="BTM" /> featuring notably [[Wikipedia:Sequoia sempervirens|giant redwoods]] and [[Wikipedia:Polystichum munitum|sword ferns]].<ref name="Park">{{WebCite|url=http://www.nps.gov/redw/naturescience/plants.htm|text=Redwood: Plants|work=Website of the U.S. National Park Service|archivedate=20200422041328}}</ref>
